institutions.SEMEL_MOSAD: map-main — the institution symbol, shown in the map popup and searchable in the explorer; sort key
institutions.SHEM_MOSAD: map-main — popup title; names repeat (בית יעקב ×398), so no ranking
institutions.SEMEL_ISHUV_PNIM: skip: locality code, one-to-one with ISV_SHEM_ISHUV
institutions.SHEM_RASHUT: kpi:localities — count of local authorities in the KPI label
institutions.TEUR_TAT_SUG_MISGERET: chart-types, chart-group-stream, kpi:maon, insight:groups, map-main — also splits the stage-0 rows into day-care vs other
institutions.TEUR_PIKOH1: chart-group-stream, chart-stream-legal, chart-special, chart-gender, insight:legal, insight:haredi_cities, insight:gender, map-main
institutions.SHEM_MAHUZ: chart-districts — mixes geographic districts with supervision units (מוכרים, רישוי והכרה), labelled as such
institutions.TEUR_HERKEV_UCHLOSIYA: chart-gender, insight:gender — schools only; day-care rows all read בנות (registry default)
institutions.SHLAV_CHINUH: chart-group-stream, chart-stages, kpi:gan, kpi:school, insight:groups — stage code drives the kindergarten / school grouping and the stage order
institutions.TEUR_SIBAT_STATUS: table:reasons — detailed geocoding reason, table only
